row.reason: Thryv sells SaaS and done-for-you marketing services to local service small businesses. IAC is mainly a digital media and publishing group (People Inc., Ask Media Group search). Its Angi segment earns lead and match fees, advertising and memberships from service professionals. That overlaps with Thryv on one customer group (home-service SMBs) and on lead generation and advertising. IAC's biggest businesses, consumer media and print magazines, don't overlap with Thryv at all. Thryv has no marketplace and no consumer-facing publishing. So the overlap is partial, and it is not a direct peer.
